_comment: DevCrew AI benchmark dataset. in_scope = prompts the platform should build (single-page, frontend-only). out_of_scope = prompts the Scope Agent should reject. intents = plan-stage chat messages labeled approve/modify.

in_scope.prompt: Build a landing page for a coffee shop
Create a personal portfolio website for a photographer
Make a simple landing page for a yoga studio with a class schedule
